text:
deploy-bot: Heads-up: starting soft-unpin window runtime v8.0 -> v8.1 in us-east-1 at 04:00 PT. Affected models: context-pro, embed-lite-q. Rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Auto-pinback enabled.

nina: Note: v8.1 changes attention kernel ordering for int8 which impacted tail latency on longseq tests. We saw p95 +12% for context-pro at seq=1800 in perf lab.

rob: q: does the unpin change KV cache layout? That caused cold-start spikes last time.

emma: KV layout unchanged, but kernel reorder can increase first-token work and memory during warm-up. Watch host.mem + heatmap.

ops: Ops checklist:
1) Canary 5% us-east-1
2) Exclude sdk-2.4 from canary (`route.exclude_if sdk_version ~ "^2\.4"`) and shadow them for 30m
3) Telemetry: latency.p95, errors, host.mem, kvcache.hit
4) Abort if p95 delta >10% OR errors >0.5% OR mem +200MB
5) Rollback: infractl rollback --runtime v8.1 --region us-east-1

sdk-team: Heads-up: we have 6 routes on sdk-2.4 in region (>150rps). Shadow logs will help. We can backport a quick accept-header patch if needed.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 7012345682. Exclude rule applied; shadow job queued.

ops: Canary update 7012345695: context-pro p95 +10.8%, errors 0.02%, mem +95MB. embed-lite-q p95 +1.5%. Shadow logs show ~9 header rejects from sdk-2.4 (expected).

nina: p95 slightly over 10% threshold. Recommend pause and collect traces for 15m. If micro-optimizer ready in ~30-40m, try patch; otherwise pinback context-pro and continue with embed-lite-q.

rob: Agree. If memory rises >150MB on additional hosts, prefer pinback.

emma: I'll gather flamegraphs and first-token histograms now.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused at 7012345698 (pause id 7012345678). To abort run `deploy-bot pause 7012345678` or reply `abort`.

ops: Preparing pinback script and rollback playbook in case we need it.

sdk-team: Will review shadow logs; if patch feasible same-day we can re-run.

nina: Thanks all. I will draft a short release note calling out kernel-reorder impact and SDK gating once we decide final path.
